now: simulated protocol graphs are strong; hardware stays gated

transcribe.trigger: A named method and its source text are present and the ask is to copy the steps; quiet without the source or for graph, repair, campaign, run.
transcribe.doneWhen: Every step carries a verbatim source quote with page/line or step locator, matched by program; quantities and units appear in the quote; each skipped step is written as GAP; zero-step or unread source is a valid result.
transcribe.forbidden: Inventing a step the source skips instead of marking a GAP; rewriting units or quantities.

graph.trigger: Transcribed steps and a graph schema are present and the ask is a graph; quiet when no schema is supplied.
graph.doneWhen: Graph JSON validates against the supplied schema (validator exit 0 quoted); one node per instrument action, parameters as node fields; edges with no source handoff count 0; empty step list gives an empty valid graph.
graph.forbidden: Fake edges: linking adjacent nodes without a real handoff, or putting parameters in prose.

repair.trigger: A graph and validator output naming a failing node are present; quiet when no node is named.
repair.doneWhen: The diff of the graph shows changes only inside the named node; changed lines outside it are 0; validator output shown before and after with the node id cleared; clean graph with empty diff is valid.
repair.forbidden: Restyling the rest of the graph: reordering keys, renaming nodes, reformatting, or touching an unnamed node.

campaign.trigger: A validated graph and a goal for repeated runs are present; the skill prepares the plan and stops.
campaign.doneWhen: Campaign file holds per-parameter bounds set before the loop, a stop condition, and an iteration log schema; STARTED-BY line stays blank until a person writes it; confirmation is a person's.
campaign.forbidden: Starting or simulating-as-real a hardware run, or writing a loop with no bound or stop condition.
campaign.gate: ABSENT hardware-start, instrument control (prepare bounds, stop, and log; a person starts the hardware)

handoff.trigger: A graph file and an editor-format target, or a manually edited copy to resync, are present; quiet without an editor format.
handoff.doneWhen: After resync the diff vs the pre-edit graph shows changes only in person-edited nodes; untouched nodes that differ count 0; edited values appear; no edit gives an empty diff.
handoff.forbidden: Rewriting untouched nodes on resync: regenerating the graph, renumbering ids, or reordering nodes.
